_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.vi: Bỏ âm H: "hair" nghe thành "air" (tiếng Pháp không đọc H)
mistake.l1: French has no pronounced /h/, so “hair” sounds like “air”.

segments.text: Hair, or air? Only one of them has an H sound.
Hair. Push a little air out first, like on a cold day. Hair.
Air. Nothing at the start. Just open your mouth. Air.
Repeat after me. My hair is long. The air is fresh.

native.caption: Les francophones oublient souvent le H, donc “hair” ressemble à “air”. Pour le H, souffle un peu d’air avant le mot ; pour “air”, commence directement par la voyelle. Répète après la prof Ama et travaille la prononciation dans l’appli Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you forget the H in “hair”?
en.caption: French speakers often drop the H, so “hair” sounds like “air”. For H, push a little air out before the word; for “air”, start right away with the vowel. Repeat after teacher Ama and practice pronunciation in the Lexkite app.
